sections.title: A Hub Is a Loudspeaker
sections.body: A hub is an old, dumb box with several ports. Whatever bits arrive on one port get repeated out of EVERY other port — even if only one device cares. Imagine shouting in a room: everyone hears everything.

sections.title: Why That Is a Problem
points: All ports share ONE collision domain — two devices sending together = crash (collision).
Devices needed CSMA/CD: listen first, send, detect crash, wait random time, retry.
More devices = more crashes = painfully slow.
Half duplex only: cannot talk and listen at once.
